mapper.select: select s.id, c.name, w.code from t_shipment s, t_customer c, t_warehouse w where s.customer_code = c.code and s.warehouse_id = w.id
select o.id, p.amount from t_order o, t_payment p where p.order_no (+) = o.order_no
select o.id from t_order o where o.id in (select l.order_id from t_line l where l.sku = #{sku})
select o.id from t_order o where exists (select 1 from t_refund r where r.order_no = o.order_no)
select a.id, b.code, c.name from t_order as a inner join t_trans b on b.order_id = a.id left join t_customer c on c.code = a.customer_code
